assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA) of colorectal tissue, male C57BL/6 mice

swim: swimming pretreatment, 2 months before and throughout the experiment

sample_inclusion: Animals: Ctrl n=5, Ctrl_Swim n=5, Model n=10, Model_Swim n=10 (S2.3.p1); GEO deposits 3 colons per group (12 samples). Paper does not state how the sequenced subset was chosen.
primary_estimand: Effect of swimming pretreatment on colonic gene expression in AOM/DSS-induced CAC mice (Model_Swim vs Model); secondary: swimming in healthy mice (Ctrl_Swim vs Ctrl) and disease effect (Model vs Ctrl), which together define the paper's swim-reversed STEM profiles (S3.2.p1).
planned_contrasts: Model_Swim vs Model (S3.2.p1, S3.4.p2 pair list; paper gives no per-contrast count)
Ctrl_Swim vs Ctrl (S3.4.p2 pair list; no per-contrast count)
Model vs Ctrl (S3.2.p1; no per-contrast count)
Model_Swim vs Ctrl_Swim (S3.4.p2 pair list; no per-contrast count)
Union of pairwise DEGs = 1403 genes (S3.2.p1), 279 STEM-selected, 48 inflammation/immune genes (S3.2.p1, Fig 3K)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one colon per independent animal
normalization: paper: HISAT2 + HTSeq-count read counts, Cufflinks FPKM (S2.7.p1)

paper_threshold.text: q value < 0.05, fold change > 2, or fold change < 0.5
